label: Near the episode end, rises at GO/D2 after an unrewarded S1 visit, especially after a2.
short_terms: (phase != D1) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * np.exp((ep_trial - 99) / 4) ;; (phase != D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * np.exp((ep_trial - 99) / 4) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) * np.exp((ep_trial - 99) / 4)
terms: (phase == D2) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * np.exp((ep_trial - 99) / 4) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 u") * np.exp((ep_trial - 99) / 4) ;; (phase != D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * np.exp((ep_trial - 99) / 4) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * np.exp((ep_trial - 99) / 4) ;; (phase == D2) * (state != action) * np.exp((ep_trial - 99) / 4) ;; (phase != D2) * belief_lo * np.exp((ep_trial - 99) / 4) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) * np.exp((ep_trial - 99) / 4) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * np.exp((ep_trial - 99) / 4)
explanation: Raw candidate n of unit 45 sits saturated near -1; timing (a steep rise in the last ~10 trials of the episode) explains R^2 0.71. Beyond timing, the variance is almost entirely in the final few trials (factor exp((ep_trial-99)/4)): the unit rises from -1 at GO and D2 when the previous trial reached S1 unrewarded (strongest after a2 -> S1 rare unrewarded, about half as much after a1 -> S1 common unrewarded), plus a smaller rise at GO after any a2 choice. Effects compound across consecutive late unrewarded S1 visits / a2 choices, which an additive one-trial-back model only partly captures. Belief log-odds (lower when S2 favoured -> higher unit), D1 after no reward, and this trial being rare add little (free fit 0.37 dev vs short 0.33). Additive profile cues reach only 0.14 because they ignore the late-episode multiplicative scaling. Observed-only quantities used.
